question: Which of the following gases is essential for all aerobic forms of life?
solution:
The correct answer is __**O**____**2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **O2 gas is essential for all aerobic forms of life.**
 
• Oxygen is the name of the chemical element that has the **atomic number 8 and the letter O.**
 
• It is a very **reactive nonmetal **that is a member of the chalcogen group of the periodic table and an oxidising agent that readily forms oxides with most elements as well as other compounds.
 
• After **hydrogen and helium,** oxygen is the third most plentiful element in the universe and the most abundant element on Earth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Two oxygen molecules combine to form molecule O₂.**
 
• Our bodies have evolved to breathe oxygen, which makes up the majority of our atmosphere.
 
• Chemical elements are substances that only contain one kind of atom, such as **oxygen**.
 
• Since oxygen has an **atomic number of 8 **and the official **chemical symbol O**, an oxygen atom has eight protons in its nucleus.
